channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: “Doesn’t Feel Culturally Right”: BLACK ADAM Star Pierce Brosnan Expresses Concern About Netflix-WBD Merger
item.description: Pierce Brosnan, star of Black Adam and The World is Not Enough, shared his concerns over Netflix’s impending acquisition of Warner Bros. in a new interview.

item.title: AVENGERS: THE KANG DYNASTY Was Set To Feature Multiple Spider-Men, Ghost Rider, And Kang's Battleworld
item.description: New details about Marvel Studios' scrapped plans for Avengers: The Kang Dynasty have been revealed, including appearances from multiple Spider-Man Variants, Wolverine, Ghost Rider, and more.

item.title: SPIDER-VERSE Writer Dan Slott On Being Stopped From Using Live-Action Spider-Man Variants In Comic Crossover
item.description: Amazing Spider-Man writer Dan Slott has reflected on writing 2014's Spider-Verse crossover and being barred from using—or even referencing–the live-action Spider-Men.

item.title: Simu Liu Talks Lack Of Opportunities Since SHANG-CHI, Bob Chapek Branding The Movie An "Experiment," And More
item.description: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings star Simu Liu has explained the lack of opportunities he's received since making his MCU debut and reflects on the challenges the movie faced during COVID.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Trailer Leaks Online In Full And In Much Better Quality
item.description: The first Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer has leaked online (again), this time in full and in much better quality. Could an official version swing online before Christmas?

item.title: Paramount Continues Its Efforts To Acquire Warner Bros. Discovery, Submitting An Amended Bid For The Company
item.description: Paramount’s efforts to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery continue, as the company has amended its initial offer to include a personal guarantee from Larry Ellison, father of Paramount CEO David Ellison.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Second Teaser Trailer Leaks Online And Confirms That Thor And [SPOILER] Will Return
item.description: The second Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer has leaked online, and it focuses on Chris Hemsworth's Thor, along with another familiar face from 2022's Thor: Love and Thunder.

item.title: WEB OF VENOM #1 Will Feature The Surprise Return Of The New Red And Blue Symbiote - But Who's Wearing It?
item.description: This April, Web of Venom #1, a one-shot by Jordan Morris, Ramon Rosanas, and Luke Ross, brings back the Red and Blue symbiote costume that recently appeared in Venom...but who's wearing it this time?

item.title: James Gunn Explains Why Brainiac’s Casting Was Announced Now; Debunks Not Allowing Matt Reeves To Use Clayface
item.description: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has revealed why Brainiac’s casting in Man of Tomorrow was announced now, and debunked the rumor that he stopped Matt Reeves from using Clayface in The Batman: Part II.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Leaked Trailer #2 Appears To Confirm Several Rumors, Including Doctor Doom's Plan
item.description: The second Avengers: Doomsday trailer leaked online earlier today, and a closer look at the brief teaser may confirm several big rumours, including one about Doctor Doom's plan.
